title: How Driver recommended him, and a young pianist today
summary: Driver told Miller about him, the way word gets around; this prompts an aside about a fine young pianist Waters recently worked with.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

brought you in the Charlie Miller Orchestra.
